title: lookup_article_by_msgid / lookup_head_by_msgid / lookup_body_by_msgid share identical fetch scaffold
description:
In crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs, three functions share identical structure: lookup CID from msgid_map, fetch wire bytes, split_article, look up did_sig_valid from overview_store, look up verifications. Only the final response builder differs (article_response, head_response, body_response).

lookup_article_by_msgid (lines ~994-1043): returns article_response
lookup_head_by_msgid (lines ~1103-1141): returns head_response  
lookup_body_by_msgid (lines ~1143-1175): returns body_response (skips did_sig_valid lookup)

Suggested rewrite: one shared helper that fetches ArticleContent from a msgid, then let the callsites call the appropriate response builder:

  async fn fetch_content_by_msgid(stores: &ServerStores, msgid: &str)
      -> Result<ArticleContent, Response>

Each command handler becomes a one-liner: fetch_content_by_msgid(stores, msgid).map(|c| article_response(&c)). Eliminates ~90 lines of duplicated error-handling and ownership scaffolding.
